name: headroom-token
install_doc: As headroom-cache, with HEADROOM_MODE=token. `headroom wrap claude` forwards HEADROOM_MODE to the proxy it starts, and an explicit HEADROOM_MODE wins over the default.
notes: Headroom's documented compression-first mode: 'token -- prioritize compression; prior turns may be rewritten for max savings'. It is identical to headroom-cache except for the mode, so the pair isolates the mode setting. The earlier 120-pair study never recorded which mode it ran. See headroom-cache for why this replaces THOL's own headroom entry and why the retrieve MCP server is declared.
